findings.claim: The packed-consumer verifier reports `workspaceSourceAliasesPresent: false` while only scanning `next.config.ts`, leaving copied workspace source aliases in the external app.
findings.evidence: The verifier copies the whole example app excluding only `node_modules` and `.next` (`scripts/verify-nextjs-app-router-example.mjs` lines 65-71), then checks `workspaceSourceAliases` only against `packedNextConfig` (`scripts/verify-nextjs-app-router-example.mjs` lines 84-93) and reports `workspaceSourceAliasesPresent: false` in the receipt; however the copied app includes `examples/nextjs-app/vitest.config.mts` lines 10-11 aliasing `@prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core` and `@prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management` to `../../packages/.../src/index.ts`. This violates the `packed-consumer-boundary` criterion requiring the exact command to reject workspace source aliases.
findings.suggested_fix: Scan all copied config/source files that can influence commands in the external app, or remove/rewrite `vitest.config.mts` during packing; fail if any copied file contains workspace source aliases before writing the report.
